Files & Reports

AI Files — Your AI Agents’ Reports & Presentations in One Place

Every report, one click away.

The Files view collects everything your virtual employees produce – reports, presentations and notes – in one searchable library. Browse folders, read reports with rich formatting, play presentations in full-screen slide mode and keep your own notes right next to the agent output.

How it works

How it works

  1. Open Files – everything your agents have saved is already there.
  2. Browse the folder tree or filter by type (reports, presentations, notes).
  3. Click a file to read it; presentations can be played full-screen.
  4. Use the search box to search files and generated images at once.
  5. Create your own notes with 'New note' – they live alongside the agent files.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Where do the files come from?

Your Virtual Marketer agents save their work results – reports, presentations, notes – here automatically. You can also create and edit your own notes.

Can I download files?

Yes, every file can be downloaded with one click. You can also rename files, move them between folders and delete what you no longer need.

What does the search cover?

One search box covers your file library and the product images generated with VM Product Staging – results are shown side by side.
